title: Fused softmax and top-k
goal:
Algorithm 4 fuses the online normalizer with a running top-$K$. Write `online_softmax_topk(xs, k)`. It reads `xs` once, keeps the running $m$ and $d$ and the $K$ largest values with their indices, and returns `(v, z)`: the softmax probabilities of the top $K$ elements, in descending order, and their 0-based indices.

It must never store the full probability vector. On ties, the element that came first in `xs` ranks first, as in Algorithm 4, which swaps only when $u_k < u_{k+1}$.
hints: Keep two lists, `u` (values) and `p` (indices), of length $K+1$. Start `u` at `-inf`. Write each new element into the last slot, then bubble it up while the value above it is strictly smaller (lines 8-15).
The online update of $m$ and $d$ (lines 6-7) is the same as in Exercise 1 and covers every element, including the ones the top-$K$ list throws away.
After the loop, the output for slot $i$ is $e^{u_i - m_V} / d_V$ (line 18). Use the final $m_V$ and $d_V$, not the largest kept value.
